<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_plng_att_core.PlanningAttributesServiceSNC</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>* Service layer for PlanningAttributes Repo</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>PlanningAttributesServiceSNC</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var PlanningAttributesServiceSNC = Class.create();
PlanningAttributesServiceSNC.prototype = {
    initialize() {
        this.planningAttributes = new PlanningAttributes();
    },

    _getAttributeFieldDetails: function({
        tableName,
        columnName
    }) {
        if (!gs.nil(tableName) && !gs.nil(columnName)) {
            const attributeDetails = {};
            const gr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            if (gr.isValidField(columnName) && gr.getElement(columnName) != null) {
                const elementDescriptor = gr.getElement(columnName).getED();
                let referenceTable;
                let internalType = elementDescriptor.getInternalType();
                attributeDetails['attributeDataType'] = internalType;

                if (elementDescriptor.isChoiceTable()) {
                    const choiceList = PlanningAttributesUtil.getChoiceListForTableAndField(tableName, columnName);
                    attributeDetails['attributeChoiceList'] = choiceList;
                }
                if (internalType === 'reference') {
                    referenceTable = elementDescriptor.reference;
                    attributeDetails['attributeReference'] = referenceTable;
                }

                return {
                    ...attributeDetails
                };
            } else {
                // the columnName is not present in the table, check for one level of dot walking
                const dotWalkColumnInfo = columnName.split('.');
                if (dotWalkColumnInfo.length === 2) {
                    // only handle case of single dotwalk, for instance user.department

                    const referenceColumnNameInResourceTable = dotWalkColumnInfo[0]; // this is columnName in the resource table for instance user column in the emp profile

                    const fieldInReferenceTable = dotWalkColumnInfo[1]; // this is the column name in the reference table which is referenced by the above field department in user table

                    if (gr.isValidField(referenceColumnNameInResourceTable) && gr.getElement(referenceColumnNameInResourceTable) != null) {
                        const elementDescriptor = gr.getElement(referenceColumnNameInResourceTable).getED();
                        const referenceTable = elementDescriptor.reference; // this is the table that is referenced by the field in the resource table for instance, user field in emp profile is referring to sys_user table

                        // Now we need to get the field type for 'fieldInReferenceTable' in the reference table, for instance get the field type of department in user table 
                        const referenceTableGr = new GlideRecord(referenceTable);

                        const referenceTableElementDescriptor = referenceTableGr.getElement(fieldInReferenceTable).getED();

                        const internalType = referenceTableElementDescriptor.getInternalType();

						attributeDetails['attributeDataType'] = internalType; // for instance, this is the type of department field in the sys_user table

                        if (referenceTableElementDescriptor.isChoiceTable()) {
                            const choiceList = PlanningAttributesUtil.getChoiceListForTableAndField(referenceTable, fieldInReferenceTable);
                            attributeDetails['attributeChoiceList'] = choiceList;
                        }
                        if (internalType === 'reference') {
                            dotWalkFieldReferenceTable = referenceTableElementDescriptor.reference;
                            attributeDetails['attributeReference'] = dotWalkFieldReferenceTable;
                        }
						return {
							...attributeDetails
						};
                    }
                } // else we return empty since we do not support more than one layer of referencing
            }
        }
        return {};
    },

    _getColsForLookupTables(planningAttributeId) {
        /**
         * For now, we are fetching all lookup tables info whether they are required or not
         */
        const colsForLookupTables = {};
        const planningAttrsConfigGr = this.planningAttributes.getColumnsForLookupTablesFromConfig(planningAttributeId);
        if (planningAttrsConfigGr === -1)
            return colsForLookupTables;
        while (planningAttrsConfigGr.next()) {
            colsForLookupTables[planningAttrsConfigGr.getValue('lookup_table')] = planningAttrsConfigGr.getValue('field');
        }
        return colsForLookupTables;
    },

    _getAttributesForModule(moduleId, canBeResourceType = false, canBeTaskType = false) {
        let resourceAttrs = {};
        var planningAttrsGr = new PlanningAttributes().getPlanningAttributesForModule(moduleId, canBeResourceType, canBeTaskType);

        while (planningAttrsGr.next()) {
            let attributeType = planningAttrsGr.getValue('attribute_type');
            let attributeName = planningAttrsGr.getValue('attribute_name');
            attributeName = attributeName.toLowerCase().split(' ').join('_');
            resourceAttrs[attributeType] = gs.nil(resourceAttrs[attributeType]) ? {} : resourceAttrs[attributeType];
            resourceAttrs[attributeType][attributeName] = {
                attributeType,
                attributeName
            };
            if (canBeResourceType && attributeType == 'resource') {
                resourceAttrs[attributeType][attributeName] = {
                    ...resourceAttrs[attributeType][attributeName],
                    'resourceTable': planningAttrsGr.getValue('attribute_table'),
                    'fieldInResourceTable': planningAttrsGr.getValue('attribute_field'),
                    'resourceReferenceField': planningAttrsGr.getValue('resource_reference_field'),
					'attributeDisplayName' : planningAttrsGr.getDisplayValue('attribute_name'),
					'attributeFieldDetails': {
                        ...this._getAttributeFieldDetails({
                            tableName: planningAttrsGr.getValue('attribute_table'),
                            columnName: planningAttrsGr.getValue('attribute_field')
                        })
                    }
                };
            } else if (canBeTaskType && attributeType == 'task') {
                const taskTableAndFields = planningAttrsGr.getValue('task_attribute_table_and_field');
                let attributeTableAndFields = [];
                for (const [attributeTable, attributeField] of Object.entries(JSON.parse(taskTableAndFields))) {
                    attributeTableAndFields.push({ attributeTable, attributeField });
                }
                resourceAttrs[attributeType][attributeName] = {
				    'attributeDisplayName' : planningAttrsGr.getDisplayValue('attribute_name'),
                    ...resourceAttrs[attributeType][attributeName],
                    attributeTableAndFields
                };
            }

            const planningAttributeId = planningAttrsGr.getValue('sys_id');
            resourceAttrs[attributeType][attributeName]['fieldOnLookupTables'] = this._getColsForLookupTables(planningAttributeId);

        }
        return resourceAttrs;
    },

    getPlanningAttributesForCP() {
        const canBeResourceType = true;
        let cpAttributes = this._getAttributesForModule(PlanningAttributeConstants.CAPACITY_PLANNING, canBeResourceType);
        return cpAttributes['resource'];
    },

	getAttributeIdFromAttributes(lookupField, lookupTable, attributes, lookupRecord) {
		let attributeId = '';
		Object.keys(attributes).forEach((attribute) => {
		const attributeObj = attributes[attribute];
		
		const allocLookupField = attributeObj?.fieldOnLookupTables[lookupTable];
		if(!gs.nil(allocLookupField) && allocLookupField === lookupField)
			attributeId = lookupRecord.getValue(allocLookupField);
		});
		return attributeId;
	},

    getPlanningAttributesForRM() {
        const canBeResourceType = true;
        let rmAttributes = this._getAttributesForModule(PlanningAttributeConstants.RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT, canBeResourceType);
        return rmAttributes['resource'] ? rmAttributes['resource'] : {};
    },

    getPlanningAttributesForFinancials(canBeResourceType=true, canBeTaskType=true) {
        let fmAttributes = this._getAttributesForModule(PlanningAttributeConstants.FINANCIALS, canBeResourceType, canBeTaskType);
        return { ...fmAttributes['resource'], ...fmAttributes['task'] };
    },

	getLookupTablesForModules({
		isRPEnabled,
		isCPEnabled,
		isFinEnabled
	}) {
		return [...new Set([
			...(isRPEnabled === "1" ? PlanningAttributeConstants.LOOKUP_TABLES_PER_MODULE.RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT : []),
			...(isCPEnabled === "1" ? PlanningAttributeConstants.LOOKUP_TABLES_PER_MODULE.CAPACITY_PLANNING : []),
			...(isFinEnabled === "1" ? PlanningAttributeConstants.LOOKUP_TABLES_PER_MODULE.FINANCIALS : []),
		])];
	},

    createColConfigsForAttribute(planningAttrGr=null) {
		if(gs.nil(planningAttrGr))
			return null;
			
		const lookupTables = this.getLookupTablesForModules({
			isRPEnabled: planningAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_rm'),
			isCPEnabled: planningAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_cp'),
			isFinEnabled: planningAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_fin')
		});
		const attributeId = planningAttrGr.getValue('sys_id');
		lookupTables.forEach((lookupTable) => this.planningAttributes.createPlanningAttributeColConfig({
			attributeId,
			lookupTable,
			isRequired: true
		}));
		return attributeId;
    },

	refreshRequiredColConfigsForAttr(prevPlngAttrGr, currentPlngAttrGr) {
		if(gs.nil(prevPlngAttrGr) || gs.nil(currentPlngAttrGr))
			return null;
		
		const prevLookupTables = this.getLookupTablesForModules({
			isRPEnabled: prevPlngAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_rm'),
			isCPEnabled: prevPlngAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_cp'),
			isFinEnabled: prevPlngAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_fin')
		});
		const currentLookupTables = this.getLookupTablesForModules({
			isRPEnabled: currentPlngAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_rm'),
			isCPEnabled: currentPlngAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_cp'),
			isFinEnabled: currentPlngAttrGr.getValue('enable_for_fin')
		});
		const arrayUtil = new global.ArrayUtil();
		const lookupTablesNeedsToBeDisabled = arrayUtil.diff(prevLookupTables, currentLookupTables);
		const lookupTablesNeedsToBeEnabled = arrayUtil.diff(currentLookupTables, prevLookupTables);
		const attributeId = currentPlngAttrGr.getValue('sys_id');
		
		if(lookupTablesNeedsToBeDisabled.length > 0) {
			this.planningAttributes.disablePlanningAttrColConfig({
				attributeId,
				lookupTables: lookupTablesNeedsToBeDisabled
			});
		}
		if(lookupTablesNeedsToBeEnabled.length > 0) {
			this.planningAttributes.enablePlanningAttrColConfig({
				attributeId,
				lookupTables: lookupTablesNeedsToBeEnabled
			});
		}
		return attributeId;
	},

	getEnabledModules(planningAttrRec) {
		var enabledModules = [];
		if(planningAttrRec != null) {
			if(planningAttrRec.getValue('enable_for_rm') == true)
				enabledModules.push(gs.getMessage('Resource Management'));
			if(planningAttrRec.getValue('enable_for_cp') == true)
				enabledModules.push(gs.getMessage('Capacity Planning'))
			if(planningAttrRec.getValue('enable_for_fin') == true)
				enabledModules.push(gs.getMessage('Financials'));
		}
		return enabledModules;
	},

	getActiveCPAttributesInfo() {
		const activeCPPlanningAttributesData = this.getPlanningAttributesForCP();
		const attributeInfo = {};
		for(var attr in activeCPPlanningAttributesData) {
			attributeInfo[activeCPPlanningAttributesData[attr]["fieldOnLookupTables"]["sn_plng_att_core_cpaam_combination"]] = {
				attributeFieldDetails: activeCPPlanningAttributesData[attr]["attributeFieldDetails"]
			};
		}
		return attributeInfo;
	},

    type: 'PlanningAttributesServiceSNC'
};]]></script>
